fusions.name: Bolting Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a link that deals 12 damage, and you rush to the target first. Your movement speed rises by 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Skip Shot
fusions.desc: Skips a link across the ground that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles ahead of where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Spring Slack
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 14%.
